Short Title: Hardcoded Production Backend API Rewrites in Vercel Config
Preconditions: Branch deployed to preview/staging on Vercel
Reproduction Steps: 1. Inspect vercel.json line 8. 2. Observe hardcoded URL https://grievanceiq-gky1.onrender.com/api/$1. 3. Deploy preview branch.
Expected Behavior: Staging preview frontend must route API requests to staging backend or use VITE_API_URL
Observed Behavior: Staging preview frontend routes all /api calls directly to live Render production backend
Impact: Violates staging isolation; staging test data leaks directly into production database
Root Cause Status: Confirmed: Static rewrite overrides dynamic environment targeting
Suggested Remediation: Replace hardcoded Render URL with dynamic environment variable rewrite or proxy configuration
Regression Test Recommendation: Add automated CI check ensuring vercel.json contains no production domains

Short Title: CORS Fail-Closed Empty Origin List in Staging Environment
Reproduction Steps: 1. Set APP_ENV=staging in .env. 2. Leave CLIENT_URL empty. 3. Start backend. 4. Send request from staging origin.
Expected Behavior: Server should warn on startup that no staging origins are allowed or support designated preview domains
Observed Behavior: configuredOrigins evaluates to empty array []. All browser cross-origin requests immediately fail with CORS error
Impact: Staging frontend completely blocked from communicating with staging API
Root Cause Status: Confirmed: getAllowedOrigins() returns empty array when origins are unconfigured
Suggested Remediation: Add startup validation check throwing explicit configuration error if APP_ENV=staging and CLIENT_URL is empty
Regression Test Recommendation: Add unit test in cors.test.js asserting startup configuration validation on empty staging origins

Short Title: PWA Install Prompt Banner Occludes Mobile Interactive Elements
Reproduction Steps: 1. Open Chrome at 375x667. 2. Navigate to /. 3. Observe fixed bottom banner covering CTA buttons.
Expected Behavior: PWA banner should be dismissible persistently or positioned above footer actions
Observed Behavior: PWA prompt sits fixed at bottom over action buttons and reappears upon navigation
Impact: Poor mobile user experience and obstructed interactive buttons
Root Cause Status: Confirmed: Fixed positioning without persistent localStorage dismissal state
Suggested Remediation: Add localStorage dismissal flag and adjust bottom padding or banner placement
Regression Test Recommendation: Add Playwright viewport test in 06-responsive-a11y.spec.js testing mobile CTA visibility with PWA prompt

Short Title: Ineffective Dynamic Import and Chunk Size Exceeding 500kB in Frontend Bundle
Reproduction Steps: 1. Run npm run build in frontend directory. 2. Inspect Vite output logs.
Expected Behavior: Code-splitting should cleanly separate large vendor libraries into independent chunks
Observed Behavior: Vite emits [INEFFECTIVE_DYNAMIC_IMPORT] for react-hot-toast and single monolithic bundle (1140 kB)
Impact: Increases initial page load time and degrades mobile performance
Root Cause Status: Confirmed: react-hot-toast statically imported across multiple pages while dynamically imported in PWA prompt
Suggested Remediation: Remove redundant dynamic import and configure manualChunks in vite.config.js for recharts and leaflet
Regression Test Recommendation: Add bundle size threshold test in frontend CI workflow

Short Title: Deprecated loadModel Call in QA Comprehensive Audit Script
Expected Behavior: Script executes all 8 audit sections seamlessly
Observed Behavior: Crashes with TypeError: loadModel is not a function at line 229
Impact: QA audit script cannot be run by automation or new engineers without failure
Root Cause Status: Confirmed: Relationship model was migrated to Python service; Node loadModel export was removed
Suggested Remediation: Removed deprecated loadModel import and updated script to verify Python model provider (Fixed during audit)

Short Title: Regex Mismatch in Candidate Retrieval Query Specification Test
Expected Behavior: Query pattern validation reports PASS for PostgREST category.in.(...) format
Observed Behavior: Reports FAIL because regex expected category.in(...) without dot
Impact: Produces false-negative audit warning during QA verification
Root Cause Status: Confirmed: Regex omitted escape for dot between in and parenthesis (Fixed during audit)
Suggested Remediation: Updated regex pattern to /^category\.in\.\(.../ (Fixed during audit)

Short Title: Random Forest Relationship Classifier Over-Weights Semantic Similarity for Distant Complaints
Preconditions: Pair of complaints with same category and high semantic similarity but 8km+ distance
Reproduction Steps: 1. Create complaint A (pothole city A) and complaint B (pothole city B). 2. Extract 20 features. 3. Call RF predict.
Expected Behavior: Model should output Independent or Similar since municipal issues in distant locations cannot be duplicates
Observed Behavior: Model outputs Duplicate (probability 0.50) due to tree splits prioritizing semantic_similarity and same_category
Impact: Risks false merging of complaints across municipal wards if dual-gate deterministic filter is bypassed
Root Cause Status: Confirmed: Model trained on synthetic pairs where semantic similarity had high feature importance
Suggested Remediation: Ensure business logic always enforces locationScore > 0 in duplicateDetectionService.js prior to relationship classification
Regression Test Recommendation: Add unit test in relationship_corrected.test.js asserting spatial gating on distant pairs

Short Title: Unbounded Concurrency in Backend Restart Stale Complaint Recovery
Preconditions: Restarting backend with many PENDING complaints and Redis offline
Reproduction Steps: 1. Populate 50 complaints in PENDING status. 2. Stop Redis. 3. Restart backend.
Expected Behavior: Stale complaints should be processed sequentially or throttled to prevent resource exhaustion
Observed Behavior: All stale complaints have processComplaintLogic triggered simultaneously with setTimeout(...
Root Cause Status: Potential CPU and memory exhaustion on resource-constrained free-tier hosting (e.g. 512MB RAM)
Suggested Remediation: Confirmed: for loop iterates over all records without p-limit or concurrency throttling
Regression Test Recommendation: Introduce p-limit(2) or sequential promise chain for in-memory recovery
Novelty Status: Simulate restart recovery with 50 mocked pending complaints and assert max concurrent workers <= 2
